sql: SELECT ISNULL(FaultRemarks, '') AS FaultName, ISNULL(ps.Name, '') AS SeverityName, FlowStatus AS ResultName, dye.ChangeIDListToEmpName(a.HandlerIDs, ';') AS HandlerNames, a.SheetSeries, a.SheetNo, a.SheetDate, a.SheetKind, a.MachineID, a.EmpID, ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), a.HappenTime, 120), '') AS HappenTime, a.ApplyTime, a.DeptID, a.ShiftID, a.FaultID, a.SeverityID, a.HandlerIDs, a.Handlers, a.StartTime, ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), a.EndTime, 120), '') AS EndTime, a.ResultID, a.ApproveDate, a.Approver, a.SheetStatus, a.StepNo, a.PrintTimes, a.Revisions, a.Remarks, a.Creater, a.CreateDate, a.Modifyer, a.ModifyDate, a.HandleIdea, a.RightStatus, a.PhotoAddress, a.ApproveIdea, a.PatrolDetailNo, a.SheetType, a.StationID, a.BusinessUnitID, a1.Name AS reqRepair, a1.Name + '  ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), a.SheetDate, 120) AS nameAndreqDate, ISNULL(a.StartTime, a.EndTime) AS repairTime, dye.ChangeIDListToEmpName(a.HandlerIDs, ';') + '  ' + ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), ISNULL(a.StartTime, a.EndTime), 120), '') AS repairAndrepairTime, a.FlowStatus, ISNULL(ms.BackColor, '#000000') AS BackColor, ISNULL(ms.FontColor, '#ffffff') AS FontColor FROM dye.MachineFault AS a LEFT JOIN dye.h_Employee AS a1 ON a.EmpID = a1.EmpID LEFT JOIN dye.p_FieldValid AS pf ON pf.FieldType = 'Fault' AND pf.Code = a.FaultID LEFT JOIN dye.p_FieldValid AS ps ON ps.FieldType = 'Severity' AND ps.Code = a.SeverityID LEFT JOIN dye.p_FieldValid AS pr ON pr.FieldType = 'Result' AND pr.Code = a.ResultID LEFT JOIN dye.p_MachineFaultStatus AS ms ON ms.StatusName = a.FlowStatus WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.MachineID LIKE '%' + @MachineID + '%' AND (ISNULL(@StartDate, '1900-01-01') < '1911-11-11' OR a.SheetDate >= @StartDate) AND (ISNULL(@EndDate, '1900-01-01') < '1911-11-11' OR a.SheetDate <= @EndDate) ORDER BY sheetDate DESC

sp_App_QueryMachineFaultByPage.title: sp_App_QueryMachineFaultByPage

temps.t: SELECT SheetSeries, SheetNo, SheetKind, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), SheetDate, 120) AS SheetDate, ISNULL(mf.MachineID, '') AS MachineID, ISNULL(MachineName, '') AS MachineName, ISNULL(MachineLocation, '') AS MachineLocation, ISNULL(h.Name, '') AS Reporter, dye.ChangeIDListToEmpName(HandlerIDs, ';') AS HandlerMan, ISNULL(FaultID, '') AS FaultID, ISNULL(Urgent, 0) AS Urgent, FlowStatus, CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), HappenTime, 23) AS HappenTime, ISNULL(FaultRemarks, '') AS FaultRemarks, CASE WHEN FlowStatus IN ('待维修') THEN '已指派:' + ISNULL(Handlers, '') ELSE FlowStatus END AS ShowStatus, ms.FontColor, ms.BackColor, SheetDate AS sortDate FROM [dye].MachineFault AS mf LEFT JOIN dye.h_Employee AS h ON mf.EmpID = h.EmpID LEFT JOIN dye.p_MachineFaultStatus AS ms ON ms.StatusName = mf.FlowStatus LEFT JOIN dye.p_Machine AS m ON m.MachineID = mf.MachineID LEFT JOIN dye.p_FieldValid AS a2 ON m.businessUnitId = a2.Code AND FieldType = 'BusinessUnit' LEFT JOIN dye.p_Dept AS a3 ON m.DeptID = a3.DeptID WHERE 1 = 1 AND (@sheetKind = '' OR @sheetKind = SheetKind) AND (@hasFilter = 0 OR mf.MachineID LIKE '%' + @conFilter + '%' OR mf.MachineName LIKE '%' + @conFilter + '%' OR mf.MachineLocation LIKE '%' + @conFilter + '%' OR mf.FaultID LIKE '%' + @conFilter + '%' OR mf.SheetNo LIKE '%' + @conFilter + '%') AND (@searchMode = 0 OR CHARINDEX(ms.StatusType, @flowTypeFiller) > 0) AND (@deptID = '' OR a3.name = @deptID OR m.DeptID = @deptID) AND (@businessID = '' OR a2.name = @businessID OR m.BusinessUnitID = @businessID) AND (@aboutMe = 0 OR mf.EmpID = @empID OR ';' + mf.HandlerIDs + ';' LIKE '%;' + @empID + ';%' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.MachineFaultRecord AS mfd WHERE mfd.SheetSeries = mf.SheetSeries AND mfd.Operator = @empID)) AND (@empGroup = '' OR @empGroup = '全部' OR mf.empGroup = @empGroup)

SELECT DISTINCT pName, ChartColor FROM #s GROUP BY pName, ChartColor HAVING MIN(TotalCount) > 0

temps.t: SELECT ISNULL(d.MachineID, '') AS MachineID, d.ProjectNo, CONVERT(INTEGER, SUM(d.Total)) AS Total FROM dye.v_App_ArticleOutDetail AS d INNER JOIN dye.v_App_ArticleOut AS m ON m.SheetSeries = d.SheetSeries WHERE m.SheetDate >= @StartDate AND m.SheetDate <= @EndDate GROUP BY ISNULL(d.MachineID, ''), d.ProjectNo
temps.s: SELECT ISNULL(p.Name, TSum.MachineID) AS Title1, TSum.TotalSum AS Title2, TSum.GroupIndex, pj.PName, TDetail.TotalCount, TDetail.DetailIndex, pj.ChartColor FROM (SELECT s.MachineID AS MachineID, CONVERT(INTEGER, SUM(Total)) AS TotalSum, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(s.Total) DESC) AS GroupIndex FROM #t AS s GROUP BY s.MachineID) AS TSum LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT s.MachineID AS MachineID, ISNULL(ProjectNo, '') AS ProjectNo, CONVERT(INTEGER, SUM(Total)) AS TotalCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.MachineID ORDER BY SUM(s.Total) DESC) AS DetailIndex FROM #t AS s GROUP BY s.MachineID, ISNULL(ProjectNo, '')) AS TDetail ON TDetail.MachineID = TSum.MachineID LEFT OUTER JOIN dye.p_Machine AS p ON TSum.MachineID = p.MachineID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT Code AS PCode, Name AS PName, ISNULL(Reserved1, '#ffffff') AS ChartColor FROM dye.p_FieldValid WHERE FieldType LIKE '%project%') AS pj ON TDetail.ProjectNo = pj.PCode ORDER BY TSum.GroupIndex, TDetail.DetailIndex
temps.title: SELECT PName, title1, title2, GroupIndex, PName + title1 AS commix FROM (SELECT Code AS PCode, Name AS PName FROM dye.p_FieldValid WHERE FieldType LIKE '%project%') AS pj, (SELECT DISTINCT title1 AS title1, title2 AS title2, GroupIndex AS GroupIndex FROM #s) AS s

Sp_WorkQty_AvueDate_Query.title: Sp_WorkQty_AvueDate_Query
sql: SELECT t.Days, p.Code, t.ProcessName, CONVERT(NUMERIC(10, 1), t.CurrRolls) AS CurrRolls, CONVERT(NUMERIC(16, 2), t.CurrKg) AS CurrKg FROM #t AS t JOIN (SELECT Code AS Code, Name AS ProcessName FROM dye.p_FieldValid WHERE FieldType = 'Station') AS p ON p.Code = t.StationID ORDER BY t.Days, p.Code

temps.t: SELECT DG.Days, StationID, DG.ProcessName, DG.Num, SUM(CurrRolls) AS CurrRolls, SUM(CurrKg) AS CurrKg FROM (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(MINUTE, -470, a.EndTime), 120) AS Days, a.StationID, CASE WHEN a.StationID = '03' AND a.ProcessID IN ('GX31', 'GX54') THEN '成品定型' WHEN a.StationID = '03' AND a.ProcessID IN ('GX22', 'GX35', 'GX58') THEN '干布' WHEN a.StationID = '03' AND a.ProcessID IN ('GX60', 'GX100') THEN '缩胚' WHEN a.StationID = '03' THEN p.Name WHEN a.StationID = '08' THEN f.StationName WHEN a.StationID = '01' THEN f.StationName WHEN a.StationID = '15' THEN f.StationName WHEN a.StationID = '14' THEN '平幅水洗' ELSE f.StationName END AS ProcessName, CASE WHEN a.StationID = '12' THEN 1 WHEN a.StationID = '14' THEN 2 WHEN a.StationID = '01' THEN 3 WHEN a.StationID = '02' THEN 4 WHEN a.StationID = '08' THEN 7 WHEN a.StationID = '03' THEN 8 WHEN a.StationID = '04' THEN 9 WHEN a.StationID = '15' THEN 5 WHEN a.StationID = '10' THEN 10 ELSE 11 END AS Num, CurrRolls, CAST(CurrKg / 1000 AS NUMERIC(16, 2)) AS CurrKg FROM dye.WProcess AS a JOIN dye.p_Process AS p ON p.ProcessID = a.ProcessID LEFT JOIN (SELECT Code AS Code, Name AS StationName FROM dye.p_FieldValid WHERE FieldType = 'Station') AS f ON f.Code = p.StationID WHERE a.StationID <> '02' AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(MINUTE, -470, a.EndTime), 120) >= @dsDate AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(MINUTE, -470, a.EndTime), 120) <= @dtDate UNION ALL SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(MINUTE, -470, CreateDate), 120) AS Days, '02' AS StationID, '染色' AS ProcessName, 4 AS Num, Rolls AS CurrRolls, CAST(WeightQty / 1000 AS NUMERIC(16, 2)) AS CurrKg FROM dye.JobSheetReceive WHERE ISNULL(JobSheetNo, '') <> '' AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(MINUTE, -470, CreateDate), 120) >= @dsDate AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(MINUTE, -470, CreateDate), 120) <= @dtDate) AS DG GROUP BY DG.Days, StationID, DG.ProcessName, DG.Num

sql:
WITH
DyeStateCTE AS (
SELECT
JobSheetNo,
MAX(DyeState) AS DyeState
FROM dye.vw_ProcessDyMachine_FB
WHERE JobSheetNo IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY JobSheetNo
),
CombineCTE AS (
SELECT
SheetSeries,
STRING_AGG(CustSelfNo, ';') AS Str_CustSelfNo
FROM dye.JobCombineOrder
GROUP BY SheetSeries
)
SELECT
pd.NUM,
pd.StereotypesName,
ISNULL(CASE
WHEN ISNULL(js.CurrProcessID,'') = '已发纱出库' AND ISNULL(ds.DyeState,'') = ''
THEN '已' +js.CurrProcessID
ELSE '已' +ds.DyeState
END, '') AS DyeState,
co.Str_CustSelfNo,
ps.*,
js.BarCode,
js.CustomerID,
js.ProdID,
js.ColorNum,
ISNULL(js.SumProcessRolls, js.PreRolls) AS SumProcessRolls,
ISNULL(js.SumProcessLengthQty, 0) AS SumProcessLengthQty,
ISNULL(js.SumProcessWeightQty, js.PreVatQty) AS SumProcessWeightQty,
js.Width,
js.Weight,
OC.DlvDate,
OC.DyeDate
FROM dye.T_PSD pd
LEFT JOIN dye.ProcessSchedule ps
ON ps.JobSheetNo = pd.JobSheetNo AND ps.SheetKind = 1
LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet js
ON js.SheetNo = ps.JobSheetNo
LEFT JOIN dye.OrderColor OC
ON js.CheckNo = OC.CheckNo
LEFT JOIN DyeStateCTE ds
ON ds.JobSheetNo = ps.JobSheetNo
LEFT JOIN CombineCTE co
ON co.SheetSeries = js.SheetSeries
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM dye.WProcess W
WHERE W.ProcessID = 'GX03' AND W.JobSheetNo = pd.JobSheetNo
)
AND (@StereotypesName1 = '' OR ps.StereotypesName = @StereotypesName1)
ORDER BY ps.StereotypesName, pd.NUM

sql: SELECT NEWID() AS WProcessNo, a.JobSheetNo, a.ShiftID, j.CustomerID, j.ProdID, j.ColorID, j.ColorNum, a.ProcessID, a.EndTime, a.EmpID, b.CurrRolls, b.CurrKg, a.Qty, ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(pc.IsAbroad, 0) = 0 THEN p.Price ELSE p.Price * 1.5 END, 2) AS Price, ROUND((CASE WHEN ISNULL(pc.IsAbroad, 0) = 0 THEN p.Price ELSE p.Price * 1.5 END) * a.Qty / 1000, 2) AS WorkMoney FROM (SELECT m.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, m.ShiftID AS ShiftID, m.EmpID AS EmpID, SUM(m.Qty) AS Qty, m.EndTime AS EndTime, 'GX20' AS ProcessID FROM (SELECT b.BarCode AS BarCode, a.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, a.ShiftID AS ShiftID, b.EmpID AS EmpID, a.CustQty AS CustQty, a.CustQty / c.pre AS Qty, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), DATEADD(HOUR, -8, a.PackTime), 20) AS EndTime FROM dye.RecordYield AS a JOIN dye.RecordEmp AS b ON b.BarCode = a.BarCode LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift ON p_Shift.ShiftID = a.ShiftID JOIN (SELECT b.BarCode AS BarCode, COUNT(b.BarCode) AS pre FROM dye.RecordEmp AS b WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY b.BarCode) AS c ON c.BarCode = b.BarCode WHERE p_Shift.StationID = '12' AND p_Shift.DeptID = '06' AND (a.PackTime >= @StartDate) AND (a.PackTime <= @EndDate)) AS m GROUP BY m.JobSheetNo, m.ShiftID, m.EmpID, m.EndTime) AS a JOIN (SELECT JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, RecordYield.ShiftID AS ShiftID, COUNT(BarCode) AS CurrRolls, SUM(CustQty) AS CurrKg FROM dye.RecordYield LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift ON p_Shift.ShiftID = RecordYield.ShiftID WHERE 1 = 1 AND p_Shift.StationID = '12' AND p_Shift.DeptID = '06' AND (PackTime >= @StartDate) AND (PackTime <= @EndDate) GROUP BY JobSheetNo, RecordYield.ShiftID) AS b ON b.JobSheetNo = a.JobSheetNo AND b.ShiftID = a.ShiftID LEFT JOIN dye.p_Process AS p ON p.ProcessID = a.ProcessID LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet AS j ON a.JobSheetNo = j.SheetNo LEFT JOIN dye.p_Customer AS pc ON j.CustomerID = pc.CustomerID WHERE a.EmpID = @EmpID

temps.t_worksum: SELECT * FROM (SELECT #T_EmpIDQty.RQ AS RQ, #T_EmpIDQty.ShiftID AS ShiftID, #T_EmpIDQty.EmpID AS EmpID, #T_EmpIDQty.SumNum AS SumNum, #T_EmpIDQty.SumEmpIDQty AS SumEmpIDQty, ISNULL(#T_EmpIDQty.SumEmpIDAmount, 0) AS SumEmpIDAmount, ISNULL(G.ShifQty, 0) AS ShifQty, ISNULL(G.ShifAmount, 0) AS ShifAmount, #T_EmpIDQty.SCAmount AS SCAmount, #T_EmpIDQty.ShifSCAmount AS ShifSCAmount, SystemAmount AS SystemAmount, ShifSystemAmount AS ShifSystemAmount, OtherAmount AS OtherAmount, ShifOtherAmount AS ShifOtherAmount, CASE WHEN StationID = '07' AND SumNum = 4 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), G.ShifAmount / SumNum) WHEN StationID = '07' AND SumNum > 4 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), G.ShifAmount / SumNum * ((SumNum - 4) * 0.5 + 1)) WHEN StationID = '01' AND SumNum = 5 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), G.ShifAmount / SumNum) WHEN StationID = '01' AND SumNum > 5 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), G.ShifAmount / SumNum * ((SumNum - 5) * 0.5 + 1)) ELSE NULL END AS Supplements FROM #T_EmpIDQty LEFT JOIN (SELECT RQ AS RQ, ShiftID AS ShiftID, SUM(SumEmpIDQty) AS ShifQty, SUM(SumEmpIDAmount) AS ShifAmount FROM #T_EmpIDQty GROUP BY RQ, ShiftID) AS G ON G.RQ = #T_EmpIDQty.RQ AND G.ShiftID = #T_EmpIDQty.ShiftID LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift ON p_Shift.ShiftID = #T_EmpIDQty.ShiftID) AS H UNION ALL SELECT * FROM #T_SC
temps.t_worksumnew: SELECT * FROM (SELECT RQ AS RQ, CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), #T_WorkSum.RQ, 120) AS Years, RIGHT(100 + DAY(#T_WorkSum.RQ), 2) AS RQDay, ShiftID AS ShiftID, ROUND(ISNULL(ShifAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ShifSystemAmount, 0), 0) AS ShifAmount, ROUND(ShifSCAmount, 0) AS ShifSCAmount, ROUND(ShifSystemAmount, 0) AS ShifSystemAmount, ROUND(ShifOtherAmount, 0) AS ShifOtherAmount, ROUND(Supplements, 0) AS Supplements, ROUND(CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), ISNULL(ShifAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ShifSCAmount, 0) + ISNULL(Supplements, 0) + ISNULL(ShifSystemAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ShifOtherAmount, 0)), 0) AS Subtotal, SumNum AS SumNum, EmpID AS EmpID, ROUND(ISNULL(SumEmpIDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SystemAmount, 0), 0) AS SumEmpIDAmount, ROUND(SCAmount, 0) AS SCAmount, ROUND(SystemAmount, 0) AS SystemAmount, ROUND(OtherAmount, 0) AS OtherAmount, ROUND(CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), Supplements / SumNum), 0) AS EmpIDSupplements, ROUND(ISNULL(SumEmpIDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SCAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SystemAmount, 0) + ISNULL(OtherAmount, 0) + ISNULL(CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), Supplements / SumNum), 0), 0) AS EmpIDSubtotal FROM #T_WorkSum) AS Z

temps.t_empidqty: SELECT * FROM (SELECT #T_SumQty.RQ AS RQ, #T_SumQty.ShiftID AS ShiftID, #T_SumQty.EmpID AS EmpID, #T_SumQty.SumNum AS SumNum, #T_SumQty.SumEmpIDQty AS SumEmpIDQty, #T_SumQty.SumEmpIDAmount AS SumEmpIDAmount, #T_SCAmount.SCAmount AS SCAmount, #T_ShifSCAmount.ShifSCAmount AS ShifSCAmount, #T_SCAmount.SystemAmount AS SystemAmount, #T_ShifSCAmount.ShifSystemAmount AS ShifSystemAmount, #T_SCAmount.OtherAmount AS OtherAmount, #T_ShifSCAmount.ShifOtherAmount AS ShifOtherAmount FROM #T_SumQty LEFT JOIN #T_SCAmount ON #T_SCAmount.EmpID = #T_SumQty.EmpID AND #T_SCAmount.ShiftID = #T_SumQty.ShiftID AND #T_SCAmount.RQ = #T_SumQty.RQ LEFT JOIN #T_ShifSCAmount ON #T_ShifSCAmount.RQ = #T_SumQty.RQ AND #T_ShifSCAmount.ShiftID = #T_SumQty.ShiftID) AS R

temps.t_worksum: SELECT * FROM (SELECT #T_EmpIDQty.RQ AS RQ, #T_EmpIDQty.ShiftID AS ShiftID, #T_EmpIDQty.EmpID AS EmpID, #T_EmpIDQty.SumNum AS SumNum, #T_EmpIDQty.SumEmpIDQty AS SumEmpIDQty, ISNULL(#T_EmpIDQty.SumEmpIDAmount, 0) AS SumEmpIDAmount, ISNULL(G.ShifQty, 0) AS ShifQty, ISNULL(G.ShifAmount, 0) AS ShifAmount, #T_EmpIDQty.SCAmount AS SCAmount, #T_EmpIDQty.ShifSCAmount AS ShifSCAmount, SystemAmount AS SystemAmount, ShifSystemAmount AS ShifSystemAmount, OtherAmount AS OtherAmount, ShifOtherAmount AS ShifOtherAmount, CASE WHEN StationID = '07' AND SumNum = 4 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), G.ShifAmount / SumNum) WHEN StationID = '07' AND SumNum > 4 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), G.ShifAmount / SumNum * ((SumNum - 4) * 0.5 + 1)) WHEN StationID = '01' AND SumNum = 5 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), G.ShifAmount / SumNum) WHEN StationID = '01' AND SumNum > 5 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), G.ShifAmount / SumNum * ((SumNum - 5) * 0.5 + 1)) ELSE NULL END AS Supplements FROM #T_EmpIDQty LEFT JOIN (SELECT RQ AS RQ, ShiftID AS ShiftID, SUM(SumEmpIDQty) AS ShifQty, SUM(SumEmpIDAmount) AS ShifAmount FROM #T_EmpIDQty GROUP BY RQ, ShiftID) AS G ON G.RQ = #T_EmpIDQty.RQ AND G.ShiftID = #T_EmpIDQty.ShiftID LEFT JOIN dye.p_Shift ON p_Shift.ShiftID = #T_EmpIDQty.ShiftID) AS H UNION ALL SELECT * FROM #T_SC
temps.t_worksumnew: SELECT * FROM (SELECT RQ AS RQ, CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), #T_WorkSum.RQ, 120) AS Years, RIGHT(100 + DAY(#T_WorkSum.RQ), 2) AS RQDay, ShiftID AS ShiftID, ROUND(ISNULL(ShifAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ShifSystemAmount, 0), 0) AS ShifAmount, ROUND(ShifSCAmount, 0) AS ShifSCAmount, ROUND(ShifSystemAmount, 0) AS ShifSystemAmount, ROUND(ShifOtherAmount, 0) AS ShifOtherAmount, ROUND(Supplements, 0) AS Supplements, ROUND(CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), ISNULL(ShifAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ShifSCAmount, 0) + ISNULL(Supplements, 0) + ISNULL(ShifSystemAmount, 0) + ISNULL(ShifOtherAmount, 0)), 0) AS Subtotal, SumNum AS SumNum, EmpID AS EmpID, ROUND(ISNULL(SumEmpIDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SystemAmount, 0), 0) AS SumEmpIDAmount, ROUND(SCAmount, 0) AS SCAmount, ROUND(SystemAmount, 0) AS SystemAmount, ROUND(OtherAmount, 0) AS OtherAmount, ROUND(CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), Supplements / SumNum), 0) AS EmpIDSupplements, ROUND(ISNULL(SumEmpIDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SCAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SystemAmount, 0) + ISNULL(OtherAmount, 0) + ISNULL(CONVERT(NUMERIC(8, 2), Supplements / SumNum), 0), 0) AS EmpIDSubtotal FROM #T_WorkSum) AS Z

SP_WDefectList.title: SP_WDefectList
sql: SELECT NEWID() AS ID, #t1.*, FORMAT(#t2.DefectQty / NULLIF(#t3.DefectQty, 0), 'P') AS bl1, CASE WHEN #t4.Defects = 'dt003' THEN '染部责任' + FORMAT(#t4.DefectQty / NULLIF(#t3.DefectQty, 0), 'P') WHEN #t4.Defects = 'dt004' THEN '定型部责任' + FORMAT(#t4.DefectQty / NULLIF(#t3.DefectQty, 0), 'P') ELSE '其他部门' + FORMAT(#t4.DefectQty / NULLIF(#t3.DefectQty, 0), 'P') END AS bl2 FROM #t1 LEFT JOIN #t2 ON #t2.SheetDate = #t1.SheetDate AND #t2.DefectKind = #t1.DefectKind LEFT JOIN #t3 ON #t3.SheetDate = #t1.SheetDate LEFT JOIN #t4 ON #t4.SheetDate = #t1.SheetDate AND #t4.Defects = #t1.Defects WHERE 1 = 1

temps.t1: SELECT a.SheetNo AS SheetNo, CAST(a.SheetDate AS DATE) AS SheetDate, a.CustomerID AS CustomerID, a.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, a.ProdID AS ProdID, a.ColorNum AS ColorNum, a.ColorID AS ColorID, a.FromRolls AS PreRolls, a.FromWeightQty AS PreVatQty, a.DefectRolls AS DefectRolls, a.DefectQty AS DefectQty, a.DefectFactory AS DefectFactory, a.DefectKind AS DefectKind, a.Defects AS Defects, a.Signer AS Signer, a.DetailCustName AS DetailCustName, a.SignedDate AS SignedDate, a.Remarks AS Remarks FROM dye.WDefect AS a WHERE a.SheetType <> 10 AND a.SheetDate >= @StartDate AND a.SheetDate <= @EndDate
temps.t2: SELECT CAST(a.SheetDate AS DATE) AS SheetDate, a.DefectKind AS DefectKind, SUM(a.DefectQty) AS DefectQty FROM dye.WDefect AS a LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet AS b ON b.sheetno = a.JobSheetNo WHERE a.SheetType <> 10 AND a.SheetDate >= @StartDate AND a.SheetDate <= @EndDate GROUP BY CAST(a.sheetdate AS DATE), a.DefectKind
temps.t3: SELECT CAST(a.SheetDate AS DATE) AS SheetDate, SUM(a.DefectQty) AS DefectQty FROM dye.WDefect AS a LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet AS b ON b.sheetno = a.JobSheetNo WHERE a.SheetType <> 10 AND a.SheetDate >= @StartDate AND a.SheetDate <= @EndDate GROUP BY CAST(a.sheetdate AS DATE)
temps.t4: SELECT CAST(a.SheetDate AS DATE) AS SheetDate, Defects AS Defects, SUM(a.DefectQty) AS DefectQty FROM dye.WDefect AS a LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet AS b ON b.sheetno = a.JobSheetNo WHERE a.SheetType <> 10 AND a.SheetDate >= @StartDate AND a.SheetDate <= @EndDate GROUP BY CAST(a.sheetdate AS DATE), Defects

Sp_WorkQtySum.title: Sp_WorkQtySum
sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY B.StationID) AS XU, * FROM (SELECT StationID AS StationID, StationIDName AS StationIDName, ShiftID AS ShiftID, ShiftIDName AS ShiftIDName, EmpID AS EmpID, EmpID AS NAME, SUM(A.KgQty) AS CurrKg, SUM(A.MeterQty) AS CurrMeter, SUM(A.CurrMoney) AS CurrMoney FROM (SELECT StationID AS StationID, StationID AS StationIDName, ShiftID AS ShiftID, ShiftID AS ShiftIDName, EmpID AS EmpID, EmpID AS NAME, KgQty AS KgQty, MeterQty AS MeterQty, CONVERT(NUMERIC(10, 2), Qty * ProcessIDPire / 1000) AS CurrMoney FROM #T_WP) AS A GROUP BY A.StationID, A.StationIDName, A.ShiftID, A.ShiftIDName, A.EmpID, A.NAME) AS B WHERE 1 = 1 AND (ISNULL(@StationID, '') = '' OR B.StationID = @StationID) AND (ISNULL(@ShiftID, '') = '' OR B.ShiftID = @ShiftID)

temps.t_pack: SELECT * FROM (SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), JobSheetNo + 'GX98' + ShiftID) AS WProcessNo, RY.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, 99 AS ProcessNo, 'GX98' AS ProcessID, '07' AS StationID, RY.ShiftID AS ShiftID, '' AS EmpID, RY.Kg AS CurrKg, RY.Meter AS CurrMeter, CASE WHEN J.AssignUnit = 1 THEN RY.Kg ELSE RY.Meter END AS Qty, 100 AS CurrDosage, RY.PackTime AS CreateDate, '' AS Creater, J.ColorID AS ColorID, J.ColorNum AS ColorNum, J.CustomerID AS CustomerID FROM dye.RecordYield AS RY LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet AS J ON RY.JobSheetNo = J.SheetNo WHERE 1 = 1 AND RY.PackTime >= @NewSTime AND RY.PackTime < @NewETime) AS Pack
temps.t_dpmain: SELECT DP.* FROM (SELECT WP.WProcessNo AS WProcessNo, WP.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, WP.ProcessNo AS ProcessNo, WP.ProcessID AS ProcessID, WP.StationID AS StationID, WP.ShiftID AS ShiftID, WP.EmpID AS EmpID, WP.CurrKg AS CurrKg, WP.CurrMeter AS CurrMeter, CASE WHEN J.AssignUnit = 1 THEN WP.CurrKg ELSE WP.CurrMeter END AS Qty, CASE WHEN ProcessID IN ('GX00', 'GX01') AND WP.Creater = '翻布刷卡' THEN 100 ELSE WP.CurrDosage END AS CurrDosage, WP.CreateDate AS CreateDate, WP.Creater AS Creater, J.ColorID AS ColorID, J.ColorNum AS ColorNum, J.CustomerID AS CustomerID FROM dye.WProcess AS WP LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet AS J ON J.SheetNo = WP.JobSheetNo WHERE 1 = 1 AND WP.CreateDate >= @NewSTime AND WP.CreateDate < @NewETime) AS DP
temps.t_packnew: SELECT * FROM (SELECT WProcessNo AS WProcessNo, JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, ProcessNo AS ProcessNo, ProcessID AS ProcessID, StationID AS StationID, ShiftID AS ShiftID, EmpID AS EmpID, SUM(CurrKg) AS CurrKg, SUM(CurrMeter) AS CurrMeter, SUM(Qty) AS Qty, CurrDosage AS CurrDosage, CreateDate AS CreateDate, Creater AS Creater, ColorID AS ColorID, ColorNum AS ColorNum, CustomerID AS CustomerID FROM #T_Pack GROUP BY WProcessNo, JobSheetNo, ProcessNo, ProcessID, StationID, ShiftID, EmpID, CurrDosage, CreateDate, Creater, ColorID, ColorNum, CustomerID) AS NewPack
temps.allprocessid: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM #T_DPMain UNION ALL SELECT * FROM #T_PackNew) AS DPPack
temps.t_wp: SELECT *, dye.fn_ProcessIDPire(D.JobSheetNo, D.ProcessID, D.Qty) AS ProcessIDPire FROM (SELECT WP.WProcessNo AS WProcessNo, WP.JobSheetNo AS JobSheetNo, WP.ProcessID AS ProcessID, WP.StationID AS StationID, WP.ShiftID AS ShiftID, WP.EmpID AS EmpID, WP.CurrKg AS CurrKg, WP.CurrMeter AS CurrMeter, CASE WHEN J.AssignUnit = 1 THEN WP.CurrKg * ISNULL(WP.CurrDosage, 0) / 100 ELSE WP.CurrMeter * ISNULL(WP.CurrDosage, 0) / 100 END AS Qty, CASE WHEN J.AssignUnit = 1 THEN WP.CurrKg * ISNULL(WP.CurrDosage, 0) / 100 ELSE 0.00 END AS KgQty, CASE WHEN J.AssignUnit = 0 THEN WP.CurrMeter * ISNULL(WP.CurrDosage, 0) / 100 ELSE 0.00 END AS MeterQty, CASE WHEN ProcessID IN ('GX00', 'GX01') AND WP.Creater = '翻布刷卡' THEN 100 ELSE WP.CurrDosage END AS CurrDosage, WP.CreateDate AS CreateDate, J.ColorID AS ColorID, J.ColorNum AS ColorNum, J.CustomerID AS CustomerID FROM #AllProcessID AS WP LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet AS J ON J.SheetNo = WP.JobSheetNo) AS D
